claim_boundary: Cycle C007 derives ten child hypotheses from existing JANUS nodes, attacks them immediately, and records one decisive refutation of an ancestor. None of H060-H069 is proved or certified novel.
inheritance_rule: Every H060+ entry names derived_from parents and a delta_from_parents that states the new obligation.

hypotheses.title: Hard-DNF Extended-Frege Rewriting-Pair Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Assuming the explicit DNF family T_n in H026 is tautological for infinitely many n, let C_n be its canonical bounded-fan-in circuit and let D_n be the constant-one circuit under a fixed padding convention. Every chain from C_n to D_n in the local circuit-rewriting relation used by H035 has length n^omega(1).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Together with the circuit-rewriting simulation of Extended Frege, this would give an explicit superpolynomial Extended-Frege lower bound and imply NP != coNP, hence P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: TARGET_SELECTION: turn the abstract endpoint search in H035 into a concrete equivalent-circuit pair already tied to a modern bounded-depth proof-hardness candidate.
hypotheses.next_gate: Resolve H026's tautologicity branch and define a representation-sensitive potential that is Lipschitz under each permitted rewrite but separates C_n from the padded constant circuit.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H065 chooses explicit endpoints for H035 rather than leaving the equivalent circuit pair existential, while reusing H026's exact candidate formulas.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-length legal rewriting chain from C_n to D_n for infinitely many tautological lengths.
A falsifying assignment to T_n for all sufficiently large n.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H065 is conditional on the tautologicity branch H026 and does not itself establish that the DNF family is tautological.

hypotheses.title: Range-Avoidance to Shannon-Error Certificate Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a deterministic polynomial-time reduction that maps a one-bit-stretch general-circuit range-avoidance instance and a candidate SAT circuit C to an avoided output whose decoding yields a valid H060 certificate: a witnessed false negative, a terminal false positive, or a local Shannon inconsistency on a padded restriction triple.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Any polynomial-time algorithm for the selected range-avoidance instances would construct certified errors against every polynomial-size SAT circuit and, through H060, imply SAT not in P/poly and P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: repair H056's negative-certificate gap by targeting the locally checkable certificate language isolated in H060.
hypotheses.next_gate: Design the decoder so that every avoided string has one of the three certificate semantics and prove that malformed or duplicate encodings cannot satisfy avoidance vacuously.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H066 replaces H056's unspecified checkable SAT error with the exact Shannon-local certificate language of H060, making the range-avoidance output obligation auditable.
falsification_conditions: A valid avoided output whose decoding gives no sound H060 certificate.
A proof that the reduction requires solving an arbitrary coNP instance or uses superpolynomial padding.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The reduction would still require an independently justified polynomial-time range-avoidance algorithm to yield the final circuit lower bound.

hypotheses.title: Cancellation-or-Overlap Necessity for Certified Exact Counting Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every polynomial-size H049 arithmetic decomposition of an explicit DNNF-hard CNF family, at least one of the following must occur: an addition gate combines semantically overlapping model sets, a product gate combines factors sharing an original variable, or an intermediate integer uses signed cancellation. If none occurs and every gate certificate verifies disjoint union or variable-disjoint product, the arithmetic DAG compiles with polynomial overhead into a deterministic DNNF.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The conjecture would force every surviving H049 compiler to expose one of three precisely attackable resources—overlap, shared variables, or cancellation—and would transfer DNNF lower bounds to the monotone decomposable fragment.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: inherit the H016/H050 representation attack inside the exact model-counting route rather than treating all arithmetic DAGs as equally powerful.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove the gate-by-gate d-DNNF compilation and then seek lower bounds on the amount of overlap or signed cancellation required by an explicit CNF family.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H067 applies the projection-and-compilation lesson that destroyed H016 to the counting semantics of H049 and identifies the exact non-DNNF resources a successful compiler must use.
falsification_conditions: A nonnegative disjoint/variable-disjoint H049 decomposition of a DNNF-hard family with no polynomial d-DNNF translation.
A certificate grammar operation outside the three listed escape resources that preserves exact counting but defeats the compilation.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H067 does not refute H049's full signed inclusion-exclusion grammar; it isolates a lower-bounded fragment and the necessary escape resources.

hypotheses.title: Extended-Frege Canonical-Pair to Certified SAT Error Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every polynomial-size circuit family S_n purporting to separate the canonical disjoint NP pair of Extended Frege, there is a polynomial-time uniform transformation producing SAT circuits C_n of polynomially related size such that every valid H060 error certificate for C_n converts into an input on which S_n fails to separate the pair.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H060 would imply that the Extended-Frege canonical pair has no polynomial-size separators; with an additional uniformity step this would establish H036 and imply P != NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PAIR_ROUTE: connect the certified SAT-circuit diagonalization branch to the canonical disjoint-pair branch instead of pursuing them independently.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the exact canonical-pair encoding, construct the reduction in both certificate directions, and prove polynomial balance and padding preservation.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H068 makes H036 inherit a concrete attack mechanism from H060: separator errors would be generated through SAT self-reduction certificates rather than an unrelated pair-specific lower bound.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial separator whose induced SAT circuit has local errors that do not translate to pair misclassification.
Superpolynomial blow-up or loss of disjointness in the proposed transformation.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Circuit nonseparability alone is weaker than P-inseparability unless the uniformity and reduction conditions are fully proved.

hypotheses.title: Certified Anti-Checker to Sparse Non-Natural Property Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Uniform H060 constructors for all circuit-size exponents can be compressed into a polynomial-time decidable property P_N of N-bit truth tables that contains the canonical SAT truth-table family, excludes every polynomial-size circuit truth table at the corresponding lengths, and has density at most 2^{-N^epsilon} for some epsilon>0.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: P_N would instantiate the sparse useful property sought in H058, evade the largeness condition of natural proofs, and provide a concrete non-natural route toward the explicit NP circuit lower bound H030.
hypotheses.proof_role: BARRIER_BREAKER: convert circuit-indexed local error certificates into one sparse constructive property rather than stopping at a family of diagonal witnesses.
hypotheses.next_gate: Avoid enumerating all small circuits by finding a succinct universal verification or range-avoidance encoding whose acceptance density is provably sparse.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H069 attempts to compress the individualized anti-circuit certificates of H060 into the single sparse property required by H058, directly linking diagonalization to the natural-proofs barrier.
falsification_conditions: A proof that any property obtained from H060 certificates requires superpolynomial truth-table time to decide.
A density lower bound showing that every such useful property is large, or a polynomial-size circuit truth table satisfying P_N.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The compression step is not supplied; naive enumeration of all polynomial-size circuits is too expensive and is an explicit attack.
